messages:
Rae (SRE): Quick postmortem follow-up from today's cache-thundering outage. Need: final status-page copy, 72h customer summary owner, gated-RCA handling, and who owns recurring-pattern mitigation.

Jordan (Ops): I can draft status + 72h. Will post v1 by tomorrow morning.

Helena (Product): Keep public copy concise and friendly. Add a one-line "do I need to act?" answer.

Marco (Support): I'll gather affected-customer list and draft outbound templates. Need final wording by tomorrow 3pm.

Rae (SRE): Proposal: publish a short public summary on status page, and make the full RCA available on request for customers who need details. Ops to gate requests and log them.

Jordan (Ops) (status draft):
```
What happened
On Mar 23 a cache eviction configuration change led to a brief latency spike for a small portion of requests between 02:1002:40 UTC.

Impact
~3% of requests experienced higher latency. No customer data was exposed.

What we did
We reverted the configuration change, deployed a fix to the eviction heuristic, and added monitoring for cache churn.

Next steps
A summarized timeline will be posted here. Customers who need a detailed technical RCA can request it via support; we aim to respond within 5 business days.
```

Rae (SRE): Small wording tweak: replace "configuration change" with "configuration update" and add: "we're investigating related incidents to identify systemic causes."

Helena (Product): Also add a short FAQ entry on how to request the gated RCA and expected SLA.

Marco (Support): Gated-RCA flow: Support triages -> Ops verifies request -> escalate to Product/Eng for account-specific details. I'll add templates and mark enterprise customers.

postmortem-bot: Action items recorded: PM-4002, PM-4003. Link: https://internal.redwood/postmortems/PM-4002

Jordan (Ops): Owners & deadlines (proposed) - Public status + 72h: Jordan (Ops) due: 1 business day; Outbound messages: Marco (Support) due: tomorrow 3pm; Fix & tests: Rae (SRE) due: 10 business days; Systemic review kickoff: Helena (Product) + Rae (SRE) schedule in 2 weeks.

Rae (SRE): I'll update the tracker with PR references and ETA when branch is open. Expect gated-RCA draft in ~7-10 days. Thanks all.
